style:
Design Aesthetic: sango-ai. A coherent Chinese technical briefing with vintage engineering blueprint aesthetics, clean 2D technical illustrations and organized explanatory callouts. Rich but readable, suited to a MASS engineering team.
Background: Aged Cream #F5F0E6, very subtle paper texture and fine creases, clean light surface.
Typography: Large dark maroon #5D3A3A bold editorial titles enclosed in 【 】; technical acronyms in uppercase where supplied. Simplified Chinese body and labels in clean legible geometric sans-serif, near black #1A1A1A. All text sharp and correctly spelled.
Palette: Teal #2F7373 primary diagrams; Warm Brown #8B7355 secondary lines; Maroon #722F37 emphasis; Deep Charcoal #2D2D2D thin outlines.
Visuals: Precise 2D or light isometric schematic drawings, thin black outlines, clean orthogonal connectors. 3–5 well-separated explanatory text groups. Wide margins, strong editorial hierarchy. High information value but do not crowd.
Rules: No photos, no photorealistic renders, no glossy surfaces, no digital gradients. No logos, no watermarks, no slide/page numbers, no repeated headers or footers. Source attributions belong inside a relevant content annotation, not a footer. Do not invent text, numerical values, claims or tiny decorative pseudo-text. Schematics illustrate concepts rather than exact engineering drawings. 16:9 landscape canvas, requested 2560×1440 or other high resolution exact 16:9.
